notes.title: Version 11.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] fixed issue where sometimes strategy and depth chart would not properly load
[*] addressed issues with rare foul differences between sim and coached games
[/list]

notes.title: Version 11.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] changes made to slightly lower initial commitments prior to home visits
[*] removed players hanging up mid text/call forcing you to contact them again
[*] fix for HTML boxscore issue displaying wrong team name
[*] tweaked impact of wellness facility boost to be less if the injury is very severe
[/list]

notes.title: Version 11.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] adjusted transfer decision logic for top players to make them hold out a little big longer to wait for more offers in some cases
[*] fixed text error on key dates page for May 1st date
[*] corrected wellness button text on budget selection screen
[*] fixed bug where you could hit the buttons to change a day while simming and therefore skip a day of games from being simulated
[*] fixed issue in MP leagues or universe mode leagues where budgeting was not being subtracted properly for human owned teams
[/list]

notes.title: Version 11.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] fixed 2D issues regarding motivation and players displayed as leaving court
[*] fixed issue with parental control bar not showing properly on recruit card
[*] added offensive and defensive set called to play by play logs
[/list]

notes.title: Version 11.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] missing jersey file for player card for queens city players
[*] fixed issue where a couple conference tournaments were not showing up when viewing brackets
[*] fixed an error trying to 2D play a conference tournament game for WCC
[*] addressed issue with technical foul 2D shots
[*] made significant changes to recruiting late in the year so that schools get more aggressive and players get more open to signing with those schools so that some terrible schools aren't ending up with a team full of walkons
[/list]

notes.title: Version 11.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] removed illegal recruiting toggle from options page
[*] fixed import error when importing a CB22 league that had a long history
[*] fixed bug where you could advance past speed 9 prior to a game in 2D
[*] changed the 2D popups for stats and roster so that if you click away from the area the popup closes since some people with certain resolutions were not seeing the close button and then were stuck
[*] fixed typo on Universal Mode graphic
[*] added note to save game box and in league creation not to add characters like  periods, commas etc in save names
[*] corrected the tie logic so that for multi way ties it will consider points scored for all tied teams in games among those teams as the tiebreaker
[*] fixed issue where MP leagues could not export budgeting decisions
[*] fixed issue where championship was not recorded properly to database or coach data when watching/playing 2D finals
[*] fixed issue where Tournament Maker was using wrong screen in 2D play
[*] fixed issue not allowing teams to set a play or motivate when you have possession during a media timeout
[/list]
